wiki_text: Petronet LNG commissioned the 5 mtpa Phase 2 expansion at Dahej as of 31 March 2026, raising the terminal's total regasification capacity from 17.5 mtpa to 22.5 mtpa. The commissioning was reported by GIIGNL's own news page and corroborated by trade-press coverage (ShippingTribune, EquityBulls) citing the same capacity increase and effective date.

topic: FSRU vessel assignment background (Vasant 1 / Swan-AG&P JV)
wiki_text: As of the Feb 2026 Gujarat government construction-progress report, the Jafrabad FSRU (Swan LNG) Phase 1 terminal was 92.3% physically complete (as of 31 Dec 2025), with the construction deadline extended to 30 September 2026. Which FSRU vessel will ultimately serve the terminal is unclear from open sources: 2024 reporting describes a roughly $399 million sale of the FSRU Vasant 1 (previously associated with this project) to a Turkish buyer, while a separate Riviera Maritime News account frames the same Turkey deployment as only a temporary one-year charter. Separately, Swan Energy and AG&P announced a joint venture in December 2024 to supply a floating storage/regasification unit for Jafrabad, which may involve a different vessel than Vasant 1. GEM's current FloatingVesselName field (Vasant 1) was left unchanged pending clarification -- see india-west.qa.json for the full ambiguity note.
